family_summary: On the AI-built pages, imagery is typically simplified and re-rendered: logos shrink or turn into text wordmarks, icon fonts and inline SVGs give way to emoji, text glyphs or raster images, and broken, varied or multiple photos become uniformly cropped, rounded or placeholder blocks, with responsive and decorative image variants largely dropped.

attributes.summary: On all three sites where avatars appear, the AI-built page renders them as circles.

attributes.summary: Photos are commonly normalized into uniform, rounded or framed crops, with broken or missing images replaced by flat placeholders or dropped and many-image layouts reduced to a few images, though a fair number of raster photos are kept as is.
All three sites lose the slider's responsive, hidden or lazy-load image variants.
The transparent spacer image is not carried over.
